name.value: Nevada State Board of Medical Examiners
name.quote: the Board shall, in the interest of the public, judiciously: (a) Enforce the provisions of this chapter; (b) Establish by regulation standards for licensure under this chapter

type.quote: The Board of Medical Examiners and the State Board of Osteopathic Medicine, in conjunction with the Interstate Commission, are authorized to develop rules regarding the application process

moral_character_required.quote: Be a natural person of good moral character

degree_required.value: Doctor of Medicine from an approved medical school
degree_required.quote: Has received the degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school: (1) Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges; or (2) Which provides a course of professional instruction equivalent to that provided in medical schools in the United States approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME) of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges
accrediting_body.quote: Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

degree_level.quote: Has received the degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school

school_approval_basis.quote: Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

credential_pegged.quote: Has received the degree of doctor of medicine from a medical school: (1) Approved by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education of the American Medical Association and Association of American Medical Colleges

required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, the Collège des médecins du Québec or the College of Family Physicians of Canada

experience_source.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

duration.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada

kind.value: progressive postgraduate residency or fellowship training
kind.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada, the Collège des médecins du Québec or the College of Family Physicians of Canada, or, as applicable, their successor organizations; or (II) Fellowship training in the United States or Canada approved by the Board or the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: All parts required; also acceptable are NBME, FLEX, or combination thereof as determined by the Board
exams.quote: All parts of the United States Medical Licensing Examination

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) examination
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE; all parts required
exams.quote: All parts of the examination given by the National Board of Medical Examiners

exams.name: Federation Licensing Examination (FLEX)
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE; all parts required
exams.quote: All parts of the Federation Licensing Examination

exams.name: Licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada examination
exams.notes: Alternative examination accepted by the Board
exams.quote: All parts of the examination to become a licentiate of the Medical Council of Canada

exams.name: Oral examination
exams.notes: Board may require oral examination in addition to written examination
exams.quote: an applicant shall appear personally and pass an oral examination, if required by the Board

interval_years.quote: biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine

required.quote: The Board shall, as a prerequisite for the ... (c) Biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine, require each holder to submit evidence of compliance with the requirements for continuing education as set forth in regulations adopted by the Board.

period_years.quote: biennial registration of the holder of a license to practice medicine

value: Risk management in the performance of medical services (optional)
Medical consequences of an act of terrorism involving a weapon of mass destruction (at least 4 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness (at least 2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure; at least 2 hours every 4 years thereafter)
Screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder (at least 2 hours within 2 years after initial licensure)
Opioid prescribing and substance use disorders (at least 2 hours per licensure period for those registered to dispense controlled substances)
Cultural competency and diversity, equity and inclusion for psychiatrists (at least 2 hours biennially)
HIV stigma and discrimination training for physicians providing emergency or primary care (at least 2 hours within 2 years after beginning such services)
topical_requirements.quote: Must provide for the completion of a course of instruction, within 2 years after initial licensure, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism that involves the use of a weapon of mass destruction ... Must provide for the completion by a holder of a license to practice medicine of a course of instruction within 2 years after initial licensure that provides at least 2 hours of instruction on evidence-based suicide prevention and awareness ... Must provide for the completion of at least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure.

available.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid license from another US jurisdiction, submit proof of passage of a Board-approved examination, meet all statutory requirements for licensure except NRS 630.160, complete any additional fitness requirements, and have documentation authenticated in a manner approved by the Board. Expedited endorsement available for those certified by ABMS specialty board.
requirements.quote: the Board may issue a license by endorsement to practice medicine to an applicant who has been issued a license to practice medicine by the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States if: (a) At the time the applicant files an application with the Board, the license is in effect; (b) The applicant: (1) Submits to the Board proof of passage of an examination approved by the Board; (2) Submits to the Board any documentation and other proof of qualifications required by the Board; (3) Meets all of the statutory requirements for licensure to practice medicine in effect at the time of application except for the requirements set forth in NRS 630.160

exists.quote: the Board shall, in the interest of the public, judiciously: (a) Enforce the provisions of this chapter; (b) Establish by regulation standards for licensure under this chapter; (c) Conduct examinations for licensure and establish a system of scoring for those examinations; (d) Investigate the character of each applicant for a license and issue licenses to those applicants who meet the qualifications set by this chapter and the Board

national_certification.quote: Is currently certified by a specialty board of the American Board of Medical Specialties and who agrees to maintain the certification for the duration of the licensure

national_association.value: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME)
national_association.quote: Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada

regulatory_model.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

credential_type.quote: Every person desiring to practice medicine must, before beginning to practice, procure from the Board a license authorizing the person to practice.

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

title_protection.quote: Hold himself or herself out as a physician assistant or use any other term indicating or implying that he or she is a physician assistant without being licensed by the Board

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided by a specific statute, practice medicine, perfusion or respiratory care without being licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, mental or physical condition, or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, a mental or physical condition or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or any other substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct intended to deceive or that violates Board standards of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct: (1) Which is intended to deceive; (2) Which the Board has determined is a violation of the standards of practice established by regulation of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing controlled substances or dangerous drugs to oneself or others except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing, assisting or advising the injection of liquid silicone into the human body (except for retinal detachment repair)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, assisting or advising the injection of any substance containing liquid silicone into the human body, except for the use of silicone oil to repair a retinal detachment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services the licensee is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or which are beyond the scope of his or her training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing experimental procedures or prescribing experimental therapies without first obtaining informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, without first obtaining the informed consent of the patient or the patient's family, any procedure or prescribing any therapy which by the current standards of the practice of medicine is experimental.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continual failure to exercise the skill, diligence, or methods ordinarily used by physicians in good standing in the same specialty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence or use the methods ordinarily exercised under the same circumstances by physicians in good standing practicing in the same specialty or field.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or failing to file a required record or report
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report within 30 days any disciplinary action taken by another state, federal government, or foreign country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension or surrender of a license to practice medicine in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report within 30 days any criminal action or conviction other than minor traffic violations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to be found competent to practice medicine as a result of a competency examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to be found competent to practice medicine as a result of an examination to determine medical competency pursuant to NRS 630.318.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating a medical facility while its license is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operation of a medical facility at any time during which: (1) The license of the facility is suspended or revoked; or (2) An act or omission occurs which results in the suspension or revocation of the license pursuant to NRS 449.160.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering a controlled substance or dangerous drug not approved by the FDA (with exceptions)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise a medical assistant pursuant to Board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise adequately a medical assistant pursuant to the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine. A plea of nolo contendere is a conviction for the purposes of this subsection.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another state, federal government, or foreign jurisdiction, or surrender of license while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license to practice any type of medicine, taken by another state, the Federal Government, a foreign country or any other jurisdiction or the surrender of the license or discontinuing the practice of medicine while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner, but only if the malpractice is established by a preponderance of the evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual activity with a patient currently being treated by the practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging by a practitioner in any sexual activity with a patient who is currently being treated by the practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, or families that interferes with patient care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, members of the families of patients or any other persons if the behavior interferes with patient care or has an adverse impact on the quality of care rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the physician-patient relationship for financial or personal gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging in conduct that violates the trust of a patient and exploits the relationship between the physician and the patient for financial or other personal gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, misrepresentation, or false statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing or attempting to obtain, maintain or renew a license to practice medicine by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by any false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive or misleading manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising the practice of medicine in a false, deceptive or misleading manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or attempting to practice medicine under another name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or attempting to practice medicine under another name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Signing a blank prescription form
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Signing a blank prescription form.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing fees between licensees without patient knowledge or in proportion to services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing a fee between licensees except where the patient is informed of the division of fees and the division of fees is made in proportion to the services personally performed and the responsibility assumed by each licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding, assisting, employing or advising, directly or indirectly, any unlicensed person to engage in the practice of medicine contrary to the provisions of this chapter or the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain timely, legible, accurate and complete medical records relating to the diagnosis, treatment and care of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering medical records of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering medical records of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of schedule II, III or IV controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule II, III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully failing to comply with a regulation, subpoena, or order of the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise provided in NRS 630.2672, knowingly or willfully failing to comply with: (a) A regulation, subpoena or order of the Board or a committee designated by the Board to investigate a complaint against a physician

definition_quote.value: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy.
definition_quote.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality, including, but not limited to, the performance of an autopsy.

methods_authorized.quote: To diagnose, treat, correct, prevent or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity or other condition, physical or mental, by any means or instrumentality ... To apply principles or techniques of medical science in the diagnosis or the prevention of any such conditions. To perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of the patient electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe, administer, and dispense controlled substances and dangerous drugs as authorized by law. Prescribing authority for controlled substances is subject to state and federal law. Physicians registered to dispense controlled substances must complete opioid prescribing training. Physicians may prescribe investigational drugs or biological products to patients with life-threatening or severely debilitating conditions under specified conditions.
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

license_status_types.quote: the Board may issue: (a) A locum tenens license ... (b) A special license ... (c) A restricted license ... (d) A temporary license ... (e) A special purpose license

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must submit proof of the degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent as determined by the Board, and the standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) or a written statement from ECFMG that the applicant passed the ECFMG examination.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine who is a graduate of a foreign medical school shall submit to the Board proof that the applicant has received: (a) The degree of doctor of medicine or its equivalent, as determined by the Board; and (b) The standard certificate of the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates or a written statement from that Commission that the applicant passed the examination given by the Commission.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Has completed 36 months of progressive postgraduate: (I) Education as a resident in the United States or Canada in a program approved by the Board, the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

pain_management_education_required.quote: require each physician or physician assistant who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231 to complete at least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids during each period of licensure.

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A provider of health care located at a distant site may use telehealth to write treatment orders or prescriptions for patients located at an originating site in Nevada, provided the provider holds a valid Nevada license (including a special purpose license). The provider is subject to Nevada law and jurisdiction regardless of their physical location.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: before a provider of health care who is located at a distant site may use telehealth to direct or manage the care or render a diagnosis of a patient who is located at an originating site in this State or write a treatment order or prescription for such a patient, the provider must hold a valid license or certificate to practice his or her profession in this State, including, without limitation, a special purpose license issued pursuant to NRS 630.261.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: A special purpose license to a physician who is licensed in another state to perform any of the acts described in subsections 1 and 2 of NRS 630.020 by using equipment that transfers information concerning the medical condition of a patient in this State electronically, telephonically or by fiber optics, including, without limitation, through telehealth, from within or outside this State or the United States.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby ratified and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining the Compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant may perform such medical services as the physician assistant is authorized to perform by his or her supervising physician.

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe controlled substances limited to those schedules that the supervising physician is authorized to prescribe under state and federal law. The Board and supervising physician shall limit the PA's authority to prescribe controlled substances accordingly.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: The Board and supervising physician shall limit the authority of a physician assistant to prescribe controlled substances to those schedules of controlled substances that the supervising physician is authorized to prescribe pursuant to state and federal law.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: A physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist shall report to the Board: (a) Any action for malpractice against the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist not later than 45 days after the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist receives service of a summons and complaint for the action

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: any hospital, clinic or other medical facility licensed in this State, or medical society, shall report to the Board any change in the privileges of a physician, perfusionist, physician assistant, anesthesiologist assistant or practitioner of respiratory care to practice while the physician, perfusionist, physician assistant, anesthesiologist assistant or practitioner of respiratory care is under investigation and the outcome of any disciplinary action taken by that facility or society against the physician

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Require the person to participate in a program to correct an alcohol or other substance use disorder or any other impairment

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the Board or committee may order that the physician, physician assistant, practitioner of respiratory care or perfusionist undergo a mental or physical examination, an examination testing his or her competence to practice medicine, respiratory care or perfusion or practice as a physician assistant, as applicable, or any other examination designated by the Board to assist the Board or committee in determining the fitness of the physician

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: A person may apply to the Board to be licensed as an administrative physician if the person meets all of the statutory requirements for licensure in effect at the time of application except the requirements of paragraph (c) of subsection 2 of NRS 630.160.

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A locum tenens license, to be effective not more than 3 months after issuance, to any physician who is licensed and in good standing in another state, who meets the requirements for licensure in this State and who is of good moral character and reputation.

investigational_drug_protection.quote: A physician is not subject to disciplinary action for prescribing or recommending an individualized investigational treatment or investigational drug, biological product or device when authorized to do so pursuant to subsection 1.

scope__license_status_types.quote: Any licensee who changes the location of his or her practice of medicine from this State to another state or country, has never engaged in the practice of medicine in this State after licensure or has ceased to engage in the practice of medicine in this State for 12 consecutive months may be placed on inactive status by order of the Board.

A physician who is retired from active practice and who: (a) Wishes to donate his or her expertise for the medical care and treatment of persons in this State who are indigent, uninsured or unable to afford health care ... may obtain a special volunteer medical license

A temporary license for a specified period if the physician is licensed and in good standing in another state and meets the requirements for licensure in this State, and if the Board determines that it is necessary in order to provide medical services for a community without adequate medical care.
A restricted license for a specified period if the Board determines the applicant needs supervision or restriction.
Place the person on probation for a specified period on any of the conditions specified in the order
Suspend the person's license for a specified period or until further order of the Board
the surrender of the license or discontinuing the practice of medicine while under investigation by any licensing authority

the Board may issue a restricted license to teach, research or practice medicine to a person if ... The person ... Intends to teach, research or practice medicine at a medical facility, medical research facility or medical school in this State.

A physician who is retired from active practice and who: (a) Wishes to donate his or her expertise for the medical care and treatment of persons in this State who are indigent, uninsured or unable to afford health care ... may obtain a special volunteer medical license

The Interstate Medical Licensure Compact is hereby ratified and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining the Compact ... provides a streamlined process which allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

the Board shall issue to a qualified applicant a limited license to practice medicine as a resident physician in a graduate program approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education

A locum tenens license, to be effective not more than 3 months after issuance, to any physician who is licensed and in good standing in another state, who meets the requirements for licensure in this State and who is of good moral character and reputation.
